description: Real-browser visual verification (jsdom cannot lay out). Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. Build a TEMPORARY Vite harness rendering AccessGraphCanvas via the real pipeline (resolveMatrix with a stub resolver -> deriveAccessGraph -> applyReviewStatus) against a screenshot-like fixture, drive installed Google Chrome headless through temporary puppeteer-core, screenshot, READ the image, run DOM/computed-style assertions, fix any visual defect found (CSS/scene only, with a unit test where feasible), then delete every temporary artifact before committing.
steps: Work only in /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.worktrees/review-status-fix. Read plan.md section 4 (harness spec) and follow it exactly.

Create /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.worktrees/review-status-fix/review-status-harness.html (copy of index.html whose module script points to /src/test/review-status-harness.tsx) and /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.worktrees/review-status-fix/src/test/review-status-harness.tsx, which imports ../index.css and ../graph/tokens.css and renders AccessGraphCanvas inside a 1700x1000 container with a harness-only `.vc-graph-wrap{height:1000px}`. Fixture: stub AccessCompositionResolver + ReviewItemVM list: 'Amos Cunningham' with 3 access profiles, 1 role (containing an AP and a direct entitlement), about 14 directly held entitlements (some with very long names), `e-shared` held directly AND nested in a held AP, all four statuses mixed (mostly needsReview, several approved, one revoked, one reassigned), nested-only entitlements, 4 sources; a second user holding e-shared and a held AP with different statuses.

`npm install --no-save puppeteer-core@23` in the worktree. Start `npm run dev -- --port 5199 --strictPort` in the background (never the default 1573 port). Write a throwaway script OUTSIDE src (/Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.worktrees/review-status-fix/.tmp-verify.mjs) that launches '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' headless with args ['--ignore-certificate-errors','--no-sandbox'], viewport 1800x1100, opens the harness page on the 5199 dev server (https, path /review-status-harness.html), clicks [aria-label="Show access for Amos Cunningham"], waits for nodes, and saves /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.agents/tasks/review-status-graph/review-status-after.png plus clips (legend, one first-level node, one nested-only node, a long-label node) at deviceScaleFactor 2. Also screenshot the second user's drill-down to /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.agents/tasks/review-status-graph/review-status-after-user2.png.

Run the page.$$eval assertions listed in plan.md section 4 (icon == card == incoming-edge status for every first-level node; reference edges/cards; dash/stroke-width/opacity computed styles; legend entries; status edges after reference edges in DOM order; no cross-user leak on user 2). Print a pass/fail table.

READ each saved PNG with the image reader and record in findings what is visible: rings, icons per status, line colours/dashes matching, muted reference hairlines, legend, icon not clipped on long labels, readability in light mode. If anything is wrong (reference too faint, ring clipped, z-order, overlapping icon), fix src CSS/scene accordingly, add a unit test where feasible, and re-capture until it is right.

CLEANUP (mandatory, before any commit): stop the dev server; delete review-status-harness.html, src/test/review-status-harness.tsx and .tmp-verify.mjs; remove the temporary install with `rm -rf node_modules/puppeteer-core` (and its temporary dependencies only if `npm ls` flags them extraneous); do NOT run `npm uninstall` or `npm install` without --no-save since that edits package.json. Confirm `git -C /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.worktrees/review-status-fix status --short` lists only intended src/ changes and `git -C /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.worktrees/review-status-fix diff --stat -- package.json package-lock.json` is empty. The PNGs stay only under /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.agents/tasks/review-status-graph.

Run `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`. Commit any CSS/scene fixes made here on the branch with the gate results in the message (if nothing changed, no commit; just record findings). Never push.

findings:
Real Chrome (headless, /Applications/Google Chrome) via temporary puppeteer-core against a Vite server started in-process on port 5199 (vite createServer, since a backgrounded dev server was blocked by the tool); harness fed the REAL pipeline (resolveMatrix -> deriveAccessGraph -> applyReviewStatus). Fixture: Amos Cunningham with 3 APs, 1 role (AP + direct ent), 14 direct entitlements (long names), e-shared held directly and nested, 4 statuses, 4 sources; Bob Brown holds e-shared (approved) and ap-1 (revoked).
SCREENSHOTS (outside worktree): /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.agents/tasks/review-status-graph/review-status-after.png (full 1800x1100), /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.agents/tasks/review-status-graph/review-status-after-user2.png, clips: review-status-legend.png, review-status-first-level-node.png, review-status-nested-node.png, review-status-long-label-node.png.
VISUAL DEFECTS FOUND IN FIRST CAPTURE AND FIXED (src): (1) drill-down kept the overview grid zoom (1.8x, fitView only runs on mount) so the graph was mostly off-screen -> added FitOnSceneChange (useReactFlow().fitView on drill-in/out) in AccessGraphCanvas.tsx; (2) status edges (svg z-index 1) were drawn OVER node cards, striking through names (e.g. 'Regional Sales Manager') -> buildAccessScene nodes now zIndex 2 (unit test 'stacks every node above the status edge layer'); (3) legend panel overlapped and hid the bottom-left zoom/fit Controls (legend y831-991 vs controls y912-992) -> .vc-graph-legend-panel margin-bottom 104px (canvas test asserts the panel class).
ASSERTION TABLE (final run, all PASS): 1 icon==card==incoming user edge status for every first-level node (22 nodes); 2 every non-user-origin edge and every user edge without target icon is class vc-graph-edge-reference, dasharray none, width 1 (<=1.1), opacity .45; 3 11 reference cards, none has a status icon, user card not reference; 4a needsReview dash 6px,4px; 4b approved/revoked none; 4c reassigned 2px,3px; 5 legend has 4 icon rows + Reference only row; 6a status svg layer z=1 > reference layer z=0; 6b node wrappers z=2 > edge layers; 8 legend/controls no overlap; 9 all nodes inside pane after drill-in (scale 0.394); 7 user 2: e-shared approved, ap-1 revoked, nested e-fin/source reference with no status, no ap-3/Amos-only nodes (no cross-user leak).
WHAT THE FINAL SCREENSHOT SHOWS: whole Amos graph fits the canvas (user left, first-level AP/role/entitlement column, nested entitlements, 4 source nodes right). First-level cards have a coloured ring and one corner icon: amber ring + exclamation (needs review; e.g. Finance Reports, Customer Support St... ), green + check (HR Self Service Profile, Payroll Viewer, Build Pipeline Operator, Report Builder), red + X (Global Administrators...), blue + arrow (Regional Sales Manager role, Mailbox Full Access). Lines from the user match: amber dashed, solid green, solid red, blue dotted. Nested-only nodes (Finance Ledger Read, Sales Nested AP, Support Queue ..., sources) are muted, ringless, iconless, joined by thin light-gray hairlines beneath the status lines. Long names truncate with an ellipsis, icon in lower-right is not clipped. Legend (bottom-left) lists Needs review/Approved/Revoked/Reassigned with the matching icons plus 'Reference only (not reviewed)' with a hairline swatch, and now sits above the zoom/fit controls. User-2 shot: Bob Brown -> Finance Reports (red ring, X, solid red line) and Shared Reporting Acc... (green ring, check, green line); nested Finance Ledger Read and SAP ERP are muted reference; none of Amos's needs-review amber appears.
Minor non-blocking observation: the card's left kind-accent stripe stays kind-coloured while the ring is status-coloured (by design). 
CLEANUP: harness html/tsx and .tmp-verify.mjs deleted; vite server was in-process and closed; puppeteer-core and its extraneous deps removed with npm prune (node_modules only); git status shows only src/graph changes; package.json/package-lock.json diff empty.
GATES: npm run build ok; npm run lint clean; npm test 261 passed / 34 files. Fixes committed locally (fix: fit drill-down, keep cards above edges, clear legend off controls), not pushed.
